description: Find references that no longer resolve, project-wide: scene and resource dependencies pointing at moved or deleted files, missing autoload scripts, and a missing main scene. Returns: broken references with the file that holds each, plus stale UIDs (Godot falls back to the text path and warns). WHEN TO CALL: after moving, renaming or deleting files. Nothing else reports these until the reference is loaded at runtime. Uses the engine's own resolution: a reference whose UID still resolves is not broken. Script preload()/extends paths are compile errors - gdscript_diagnostics reports them. Requires a Godot binary; runs no project code.
name: project_validate
